thread.title: River Cities Community Calendar

author: Chad Vaughn
title: River Cities Community Calendar
text:
Saturday, Oct. 3
Breast Cancer Awareness Walk at Holzer Center for Cancer Care, 170 Jackson Pike in Gallipolis. Registration begins at 8 a.m.
Wednesday, Oct. 7
Community Baby Shower at the Holzer Leadership & Innovation Institute, located at 254 Jackson Pike in Gallipolis, from 11 a.m.-1 p.m.
Friday, Oct. 9
The O. O. McIntyre Park District Board’s monthly meeting will be held at 11:00 a.m. at the Park District Office, 18 Locust Street, Gallipolis.
Oct. 9-11
The Bob Evans Farm Festival returns to 10854 State Route 588 in Rio Grande with live music, food, vendors, live demonstrations and carnival attractions.
Saturday, Oct. 10
22nd Annual Harvest Festival at Mason Park, noon-4 p.m. at 100-114 Front St. in Mason.
Friday, Oct. 16
The 22nd Annual Respiratory Fall Symposium will be held at the Holzer Leadership and Innovation Institute. Registration will begin at 8am and the event will conclude by 4pm. This one-day event gives respiratory care professionals the opportunity to learn and review different aspects and concepts in the respiratory field. This year’s event will feature a session on ethics for respiratory care professionals. A variety of speakers will be available, including guest speakers from The University of Rio Grande, Northern Kentucky University, and The Ohio State University. All Respiratory Therapists (hospitals, long-term care, doctors’ offices, HME/DME), Homecare/DME Business Owners, RNs, LPNs, respiratory students, and others providing respiratory services are invited to attend.
Thursday, Oct. 29
Point Pleasant Halloween Block Party. Live entertainment, games, food, contests and more on and around Main Street from 6-8 p.m.
Saturday, Oct. 31
Middleport Block Party, 4 p.m.-10 p.m. at 87 Mill St. in Middleport.
